verdict.line: You lose if you let Sion freely stack Death's Caress shield damage on CS; you win by taunting him off caster minions and bullying with Vorpal Blade sustain.

brief.thesis: Shen's 67.7% win rate over 96 games against Sion comes from E (Shadow Dash) directly countering Sion's main threat: a taunt interrupts his Q (Cryptic Gaze) charge or his W (Death's Caress) shield before it can detonate, and Shen's own W (Feint) shield absorbs the burst Sion needs to win a trade. This is listed as an even lane overall, but Shen holds the solo-kill edge because Sion has no way to escape or punish the taunt lock.

theirWindow.what: If Sion lets Death's Caress sit at max charge near you, he can detonate it on-demand for a big AoE hit — back off minions until it either pops or runs out.

yourWindow.when: Sion channels Q or extends W shield
yourWindow.what: Dash in with E (Shadow Dash) the instant he commits to charging Q or holding W out — the taunt interrupts his channel and locks him in place for your Q (Vorpal Blade) and autos.

start.why: 69.3% win rate over 75 games — the passive block blunts Sion's early auto-poke and Enrage trades while you wait for E timings.

boots.why: 66.7% win rate over 66 games — Sion is entirely physical damage, so the auto-attack reduction directly dampens Enrage-boosted trades.

core.why: First item in the 85.7%-winrate path; the wave-clear and bonus HP scale your trading pattern around CS without needing to walk up for extra pokes.
Second item on all three measured build paths; keeps your tankiness and sustain climbing alongside Sion's HP stacking.

runes.keystoneWhy: 69% win rate over the largest sample (35.9% pick) — the proc punishes Sion for walking up to trade autos and heals you back through his poke.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite runs a 67.9% win rate at 66.7% pick rate — Ignite punishes Sion's lack of sustain in the early trades your E lets you force.

playing.title: Hold E for his Q charge
playing.detail: Sion's Q (Cryptic Gaze, 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown) needs a visible channel to stun — dash in with E (Shadow Dash, 16/14/12/10/8s cooldown) the moment he starts charging to taunt him out of it.

playing.title: Punish empty W shield
playing.detail: Death's Caress (W, 8s cooldown) only hurts you if it detonates near you — step away while it's active and only re-engage once it's down or expired.

playing.title: Save Feint for his all-in
playing.detail: W (Feint, 9/8/7/6/5s cooldown) absorbs incoming damage for a few seconds — hold it for the moment Sion commits to Enrage autos rather than using it preemptively.

playing.title: Life-tap with Q on cooldown
playing.detail: Vorpal Blade (Q, 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s cooldown) heals you on hit — weave it into every trade window your E opens to win the extended exchange.

playing.title: Track his permanent HP growth
playing.detail: Sion's E (Enrage) permanently increases his max HP on kills — deny him canon minion and jungle camp kills whenever you can contest to slow his late-game scaling.

playing.title: Don't duel him after level 11
playing.detail: Once Sion has R (Cannibalism, 90s cooldown) online, his sustain in extended fights evens out the lane — look to end skirmishes fast with E taunt chains rather than grinding it out.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from real games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the ability readings and tactical advice on when to use E, W, and Q are my own analysis of the live game text.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Sion’s fully charged (Q) used inside a brush. Use [E] to interrupt the charge on (Q) when engaging to gain the upper hand.
